name: auto-route
description: Auto-pick Claude model and reasoning effort per task by delegating to effort-level subagents. Optional always-on mode.

hooks.command: [ -f "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/auto-route.on" ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"AUTO-ROUTE ON: handle this prompt via the auto-route:auto-route skill. Pure chat questions may be answered inline."}}' || true
